name: Blind Eternities
aliases: the chaotic space between the planes
description: The Blind Eternities is the chaotic space between planes, filled with aether, mana and temporal energy, which only planeswalkers and godlike beings can survive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel detonates a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities to protect planes connected to New Phyrexia, potentially causing a Multiversal spark rupture.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel detonated a replica of the Golgothian Sylex in the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker's branches tear paths through the Blind Eternities, opening the way for the Machine Legion to invade other planes.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker 's branches were capable of tearing paths through the Blind Eternities and opening the way for the Machine Legion to invade other planes.

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ishikari Bindra grabs a piece of the Blind Eternities to create the artificial Aetherspark and dies.
timeline.quote: although she died in the process.

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sundering of Alara separates the shards, which drift apart in the Eternities, and during the Conflux move back toward each other.
timeline.quote: the shards separated and continued to drift further apart over time.

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King, impersonating Karn, infests Venser's mind in the Blind Eternities; Venser kills it using his planeswalking and powerstones.
timeline.quote: Venser was able to then kill the Weaver King through the cunning use of his planeswalking ability

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser helps Karn close the Tolarian rift and is the last person Karn speaks to before disappearing.
timeline.quote: Venser would be the last person Karn spoke to before his disappearance.

citation.text: "Venser", section "The Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace consults Teferi, who deduces the Phyrexians come from an alternate reality; Windgrace takes the group to the Blind Eternities to meet Freyalise, and they decide to pursue the rifts independently.
timeline.quote: Windgrace and Freyalise decide to pursue each rift independently.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin brings Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings; the Blind Eternities injure and blind Bolas.
timeline.quote: Ugin was able to bring Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings

citation.text: "Planeswalker (lore)", section "Planeswalking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon accepts that he cannot defeat the Titan and believes the surrakar spoke the truth about the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
timeline.quote: This was the chaos of the Blind Eternities made corporeal.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi travel from plane to plane, draining the color and energy from the lands they devour and leaving Wastes behind.
timeline.quote: This sapping of energy drains its magical color and leaves behind Wastes

citation.text: "Colorless", section "Flavor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Answering a reader, the author reasons that the Eldrazi, outside their physical forms, would be incomprehensibly powerful in the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: I think the Eldrazi's Ætheric nature, like the Blind Eternities themselves, would be incomprehensible to the point of madness.

citation.text: "Form of the Writer". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The author guesses that the Mending did little to the Eldrazi, who have no sparks and are native to the spaces between worlds.
timeline.quote: They don't have planeswalker sparks, and they don't planeswalk from world to world the way planeswalkers do.

citation.text: "Form of the Writer". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist describes the first trial of a Planeswalker: surviving the ignition of the spark and the shock of planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Many potential Planeswalkers have been reduced to blathering vegetables, lost in the Blind Eternities, or have just had their brains and hearts explode due to the stresses put upon them.

citation.work: Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk
citation.text: "Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Domri wakes on Naya, nearly gets killed by a Gargantuan, is saved by Cylian godtrackers and returns home through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he was pulled once more through the Blind Eternities to his homeworld

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Rite of Passage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a panic, Domri's spark ignites and he Planeswalks for the first time, seeing the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: He shot out into the Multiverse to behold the infinite void of the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thinking of the Rubblebelt, Domri feels a rush of mana and Planeswalks back through the Blind Eternities to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: And then, in a sickening lurch of unbelievable power, he shot out into the Blind Eternities once more.

citation.text: "The Burying, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth remembers Heliod and planeswalks to Theros.
timeline.quote: My blood rushed out of me as I left that nightmare world.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kiora, unable to return to Zendikar without a weapon against the Eldrazi, continues her search and planeswalks through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Not without a weapon to fight the monstrosities called the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves Shandalar, still carrying the veil and its whispers, fearing she has taken into herself the thing she spent her life avoiding.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had taken into herself the one thing she had spent her whole life trying to avoid.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: After resealing the Eldrazi, Nahiri travels through the Blind Eternities to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri cast herself through the chaos of the Blind Eternities, the space between worlds.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri called Emrakul across the Blind Eternities and she arrived on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

citation.text: Coax from the Blind Eternities (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reasons she has a responsibility as a planeswalker who knows about the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: She had a responsibility being a Planeswalker, knowing what she knew about the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Facing mind-death, Jace blindly planeswalks away across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Without conscious thought, he began planeswalking away blindly, not knowing or caring where.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs the Sylex and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Elspeth grabs it before it can trigger fully and planeswalks it into the Blind Eternities .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Invasion Tree breaks through the Blind Eternities and sends Phyrexian perfection across the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Invasion Tree broke through the Blind Eternities and sent Phyrexian perfection coursing across the Multiverse.

citation.text: All Will Be One (Phyrexia: All Will Be One, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sylex explodes as Elspeth tries to planeswalk, sending both outside the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: it exploded, sending itself and Elspeth outside the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn reaches out to Teferi across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.

citation.text: Transcendent Message (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Wrenn manipulates Realmbreaker to swap New Phyrexia and Zhalfir in the Blind Eternities, ending the invasion.
timeline.quote: Wrenn manipulated Realmbreaker to switch the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia in the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Desparkening strips most planeswalkers of their sparks.
timeline.quote: The aftereffects of the Sylex Blast in the Blind Eternities cause the vast majority of planeswalkers to lose their sparks.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia is defeated, but the invasion's repercussions ripple through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was defeated, but the repercussions of the invasion rippled through the Blind Eternities.

citation.series: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
citation.text: Spark Rupture (March of the Machine: The Aftermath, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: In the Blind Eternities Serra bestows the power of an archangel on Elspeth.
timeline.quote: bestowed the power of an archangel onto Elspeth

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: Most planeswalkers lose their sparks in the aftermath.
timeline.quote: the vast majority of planeswalkers lost their sparks

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ishikari pulls the lever and her consciousness joins the Blind Eternities, attaining the unattainable.
timeline.quote: Ishikari pulls the lever—and in that moment, as her consciousness briefly becomes one with the Blind Eternities—she really does attain the unattainable.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
timeline.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A warlord's memory overwhelms Quint; he grasps the Blind Eternities to pull free of the ghost.
timeline.quote: Firmly grasping the Blind Eternities, he pulled himself forward, through the ghost and into the open space beyond.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist gains cosmic knowledge of how to overwrite the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I know how to overwrite the Multiverse

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites, giving her the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, though her devotion stays with Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Now that Narset's Planeswalker spark has ignited, she has the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, the space between planes, and discover new worlds

citation.text: "Narset". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
